name: FullContact Company Profiles Sample (Large Companies)
description: Dataset of approximately 2,000 large companies obtained via the FullContact API. For each company, the dataset includes year of founding, detailed contact information (postal address, web site, phone), and information about key persons in the company, partly including the founders. Due to the commercial origin of the data, a high data quality is expected. The dataset is meant to complement other company datasets for market research.
